Name: Robin Nyapu Seasonal Black hair
Author: ZRen12
Description:
Gives Robin black hair, which is long in fall and winter, in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's style[/url] in the seasonal portraits by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AhCuteArt/mods?gameId=1303&sortBy=updatedAt]AhCuteArt[/url] from this [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255]mod[/url].



A mod that dyes robins hair and makes it long in the winter in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's style[/url], with seasonal portraits from this mod by [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/AhCuteArt/mods]AhCuteArt[/url]
these are meant to overwrite the files in both/either(?) [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal cute outfits[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36255]Seasonal SDV Outfit Nyapu Style Retextures[/url]
you should be able to extract it and drop the files into your mods folder, and click overwrite. Let me know if it doesn't work, or any sprites are missing.
a spare version of robin with her hair up for aerobics is included in the long hair version, you just have to rename it.

This is my first mod so please let me know what y'all think

Ive finished my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/38070]Leah edits[/url]! (Mostly) Her hair is tucked out of her face, and my computer fought it hard. It pairs well with this mod, since it was the reason i made this one originally, so please go check it out!!!
